anti_patterns.dont: Add bypass actors to develop-squash-only to allow automatic queue entry
anti_patterns.instead: Enforce manual maintainer approval for soundness paths
anti_patterns.why: Bypass actors violate the soundness review boundary and allow unreviewed writes

anti_patterns.dont: Enable merge queue in repository settings before all required workflows have merge_group triggers
anti_patterns.instead: Complete all workflow and tooling adaptation first
anti_patterns.why: Queued PRs will deadlock indefinitely because required checks will never report

preserves.behavior: Soundness paths continue to require maintainer review before merge
Squash merge method remains the sole integration mode
